matchText: Ikinyabiziga cyose cyangwa ibinyabiziga bigenda bigomba kugira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 4: Inshingano yo Kugira Umuyobozi
lawDetails: Ikinyabiziga cyose cyangwa ibinyabiziga bigenda mu nzira nyabagendwa bigomba kugira UMUYOBOZI (Conducteur) ubifitiye ubushobozi n'imyaka yagenwe. Amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda ntasaba kugira 'umuherekeza' (convoyeur).
memoryTip: Ikinyabiziga gikenera umuyobozi gusa, ntabwo gikenera umuherekeza.

matchText: Ijambo “akayira” bivuga inzira nyabagendwa ifunganye yagenewe gusa:
correctText: A na B ni ibisubizo by'ukuri
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 2: Ibisobanuro by'Ijambo 'Akayira' (Sentier)
lawDetails: Akayira ni inzira nyabagendwa ifunganye yagenewe gusa abanyamaguru (A) hamwe n'ibinyabiziga bigendera ku biziga bibiri (B) nk'amagare na velomoteri. Kubera ko byombi ari ukuri, igisubizo ni C (A na B ni ibisubizo by'ukuri).
memoryTip: Akayira = Abanyamaguru + ibinyabiziga by'ibiziga bibiri.

matchText: Umurongo uciyemo uduce umenyesha ahegereye umurongo ushobora kuzuzwa n'uturanga gukata tw'ibara ryera utwo turanga cyerekezo tumenyesha :
correctText: Igabanurwa ry'umubare w'ibisate by'umuhanda mu cyerekezo bajyamo
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 113: Uturanga Cyerekezo n'Imirongo Iciyemo Uduce
lawDetails: Umurongo uciyemo uduce umenyesha ahegereye umurongo ushobora kuzuzwa n'uturanga gukata tw'ibara ryera tumenyesha: IGABANURWA RY'UMUBARE W'IBISATE BY'UMUHANDA mu cyerekezo bajyamo, kugira ngo abayobozi bishyire mu bisate bikwiye hakiri kare.
memoryTip: Uturanga gukata tw'umweru = Igabanurwa ry'umubare w'ibisate by'umuhanda.

matchText: Ahantu ho kugendera mu muhanda herekanwa n'ibimenyetso bimurika ibinyabiziga ntibishobora kuhagenda :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 10: Uburyo bwo Kugendera mu Muhanda Ufite Amatara
lawDetails: Ahantu ho kugendera mu muhanda herekanwa n'ibimenyetso bimurika, ibinyabiziga bishobora kuhagenda biteganye (mu bisate bitandukanye) cyangwa ku murongo umwe bitewe n'ibisate bihari. Kubera ko bishobora kuhagenda muri ubwo buryo bwombi nta kubuzwa, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Ahari amatara amurika imodoka zemerewe kugenda biteganye cyangwa ku murongo umwe.

matchText: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira bigomba gukorerwa isuzumwa buri mwaka:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 14: Isuzumwa ry'Ubuziranenge Buri Mwaka (Contrôle Technique)
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bitwara abagenzi muri rusange, ibitwara ibintu > 3.5t, n'ibyigisha gutwara bigomba gusuzumwa BURI MEZI ATANDATU (6), ntabwo ari buri mwaka! Imodoka zisanzwe z'abantu ku giti cyabo (zitarengeje imyanya 8) nizo zisuzumwa buri mwaka. Ni yo mpamvu muri aya mahitamo igisubizo ari D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Abagenzi, amakamyo > 3.5t, n'amashuri yo gutwara = amezi 6; si buri mwaka.

matchText: Ubugari bwa romoruki ikuruwe n'ikinyamitende itatu ntibugomba kurenza ibipimo bikurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 80: Ubugari bwa Romoruki y'Ikinyamitende Itatu
lawDetails: Ubugari bwa romoruki ikuruwe n'ikinyamitende itatu, velomoteri cyangwa igare ntibugomba kurenza SANTIMETERO 125 (cm 125 / metero 1.25). Muri aya mahitamo igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri).
memoryTip: Ubugari bwa romoruki ya velomoteri/ikinyamitende itatu = cm 125.

matchText: Uburebure bw'ibinyabiziga bikurikira ntibugomba kurenga metero 11 :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 79: Uburebure Ntarengwa bw'Ibinyabiziga (Metero 11)
lawDetails: Metero 11 zigenewe gusa ikinyabiziga gifite umutambiko umwe uhuza imipira cyangwa ibiri ikurikiranye. Makuzungu uburebure bwayo ni metero 17.40. Kubera ko amahitamo arimo amakosa, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri).
memoryTip: Metero 11 = imitambiko 1 cyangwa 2 gusa; Makuzungu = 17.40m.

matchText: Ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini aha hakurikira :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 38: Ahantu Habujijwe Guhagarara Akanya Kanini
lawDetails: Ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini: (A) Ahatarengeje metero 1 imbere cyangwa inyuma y'ikindi kinyabiziga; (B) Ahantu hari ibimenyetso bibuza; (C) Aho abanyamaguru banyura ngo bakikire inkomyi. Kubera ko aho hose bibujijwe, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Ibisubizo byose nibyo).
memoryTip: Metero 1 ku zindi modoka, ahari ibyapa bibuza, n'aho abanyamaguru bakikira inkomyi hose birabujijwe.

matchText: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 26: Aho Kunyuranaho Bikorerwa
lawDetails: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa IBUMOSO muri rusange, ariko bishobora no gukorerwa IBURYO mu bihe bibiri byihariye (iyo uri imbere agiye gukatira ibumoso, cyangwa kuri gariyamoshi). Bityo kuvuga 'mu ruhande rw'iburyo gusa' cyangwa 'igihe cyose ni ibumoso' ni amakosa! Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa ibumoso, ariko biremewe n'iburyo mu bihe 2 byihariye.

matchText: Icyapa cyerekana umuvuduko ntarengwa ikinyabiziga kitagomba kurenza gishyirwa gusa ku binyabiziga bifite uburemere ntarengwa bukurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 24: Icyapa cy'Umuvuduko ku Binyabiziga Binini
lawDetails: Icyapa cyerekana umuvuduko ntarengwa w'ikinyabiziga gishyirwa inyuma ku binyabiziga bifite uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe BURENZE TONI 3.5 (Toni 3.5 / 3500 kg). Amahitamo yatanzwe (toni 1, toni 2, toni 24) yose si yo. Ni yo mpamvu igisubizo ari D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Icyapa cy'umuvuduko inyuma ku kinyabiziga gishyirwa ku bifite hejuru ya Toni 3.5.

matchText: Ahatari mu nsisiro umuvuduko ntarengwa mu isaha wa velomoteri ni:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 20: Umuvuduko Ntarengwa wa Velomoteri Hanze y'Insisiro
lawDetails: Ahatari mu nsisiro (hanze y'agace gatuwe), umuvuduko ntarengwa mu isaha wa velomoteri n'amapikipiki mato ni KM 50 MU ISAHA (50 km/h). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Km50).
memoryTip: Velomoteri hanze y'insisiro: umuvuduko ntarengwa ni 50 km/h.

matchText: Umuyobozi ugenda mu muhanda igihe ubugari bwawo budatuma anyuranaho nta nkomyi ashobora kunyura mu kayira k'abanyamaguru ariko amaze kureba ibi bikurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 9: Kubuza Kunyura mu Kayira k'Abanyamaguru
lawDetails: Birabujijwe burundu ku kinyabiziga kugendera cyangwa kunyura mu kayira k'abanyamaguru (trottoir / sentier) kugira ngo anyuraneho, uko ibihe byaba bimeze kose! Nta bwo itegeko rireba umuvuduko cyangwa umubare w'abanyamaguru ngo rimwemerere kuhanyura. Igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Kunyura mu kayira k'abanyamaguru unyuranaho birabujijwe burundu.

matchText: Ku byerekeye kwerekana ibinyabiziga n'ukumurika kwabyo ndetse no kwerekana ihindura ry'ibyerekezo byabyo. Birabujijwe gukora andi matara cyangwa utugarurarumuri uretse ibitegetswe ariko ntibireba amatara akurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 65: Amatara Yemewe n'Abujijwe ku Kinyabiziga
lawDetails: Birabujijwe gushyira ku kinyabiziga andi matara atategetswe n'amategeko. Icyakora, iri tegeko ntirireba AMATARA ARI IMBERE MU MODOKA (plafonnier) amurikira abagenzi n'umushoferi igihe adahumye amaso cyangwa ngo abangamire kubona. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Amatara ari imbere mu modoka).
memoryTip: Amatara yo mu modoka imbere ntiyubahirizwa n'itegeko ribuza andi matara.

matchText: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by'umwihariko umuvuduko ntarengwa w'amapikipiki mu isaha ni:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 21: Umuvuduko Ntarengwa w'Amapikipiki
lawDetails: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by'umwihariko, umuvuduko ntarengwa w'amapikipiki akomeye hanze y'insisiro ugengwa n'umuvuduko w'ibinyabiziga byoroshye (80 km/h kugeza 100 km/h). Amahitamo yatanzwe (km 25, km 70, km 40) ntabwo ahura n'itegeko. Igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Amapikipiki makuru agendera ku muvuduko w'ibinyabiziga bisanzwe.

matchText: Uburyo bukoreshwa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigende gahoro igihe feri idakora neza babwita:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 85: Feri yo Gutabara (Frein de Secours)
lawDetails: Uburyo bukoreshwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigende gahoro igihe feri y'urugendo idakora neza babwita FERI YO GUTABARA (Frein de secours). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Feri yo gutabara).
memoryTip: Feri yo gutabara ikoreshwa mu gihe feri y'urugendo yanze.

matchText: Nibura ikinyabiziga gitegetswe kugira uduhanagurakirahure tungahe:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 84: Uduhanagurakirahure (Essuie-glaces)
lawDetails: Ikinyabiziga cyose gifite ikirahure cy'imbere kigomba kugira NIBURA AGAHANAGURAKIRAHURE KAMWE (1) gakora neza mu buryo bwikora, gasukura ikirahure imbere y'amaso y'umuyobozi. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (1).
memoryTip: Itegeko risaba nibura agahanagurakirahure kamwe (1) imbere y'amaso y'umuyobozi.

matchText: Amatara maremare y'ikinyabiziga agomba kuzimwa mu bihe bikurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 48: Kuzima Amatara Maremare (Feux de Route)
lawDetails: Amatara maremare agomba kuzimwa hakakirizwa amagufi: (1) Iyo ikinyabiziga kigiye KUBISIKANA N'IBINDI kugira ngo hatagira umuyobozi uhumwa amaso, (2) Iyo kigiye gukurikira ikindi mu ntera nto, na (3) Mu muhanda umurikiwe bihagije. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Iyo ikinyabiziga kigiye kubisikana n'ibindi).
memoryTip: Zima amatara maremare iyo ugiye kubisikana n'undi muyobozi.

matchText: Ikinyabiziga ntigishobora kugira amatara arenga abiri y'ubwoko bumwe keretse kubyerekeye amatara akurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 50: Amatara Ashobora Kurenga Abiri
lawDetails: Ikinyabiziga ntigishobora kugira amatara arenga abiri y'ubwoko bumwe keretse: Itara ndangamubyimba, Itara ryerekana icyerekezo (clignotants), n'Itara ndangaburumbarare. Kubera ko ayo yose yemerewe kurenga abiri, igisubizo ni D (Ibisubizo byose ni ukuri).
memoryTip: Amatara ndangamubyimba, ndangaburumbarare, n'ay'icyerekezo ashobora kurenga abiri.

matchText: Ubugari bwa romoruki ikuruwe n'igare cyangwa velomoteri ntiburenza ibipimo bikurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 80: Ubugari bwa Romoruki y'Igare n'iya Velomoteri
lawDetails: Hakurikijwe amategeko y'umuhanda, ubugari bwa romoruki ikuruwe n'igare ntiburenza cm 80, naho iya velomoteri ntirenza cm 125. Kubera ko igare na velomoteri byashyizwe hamwe mu kigereranyo kimwe mu kizamini, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Romoruki y'igare ntirenza cm 80; iya velomoteri ntirenza cm 125.

matchText: Ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa nka tagisi, bitegerereza abantu mu nzira nyabagendwa, bishobora gushyirwaho itara ryerekana ko ikinyabiziga kitakodeshejwe. Iryo tara rishyirwaho ku buryo bukurikira:
correctText: Ni itara ry'icyatsi rishyirwa imbere ku kinyabiziga
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 76: Itara Rihariye rya Tagisi
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa nka tagisi bitegerereza abantu mu nzira nyabagendwa bishobora gushyirwaho ITARA RY'ICYATSI rishyirwa imbere ku gisenge ryerekana ko ikinyabiziga kitakodeshejwe. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Ni itara ry'icyatsi rishyirwa imbere ku kinyabiziga).
memoryTip: Tagisi idakodeshejwe igira itara ry'icyatsi imbere ku kinyabiziga.

matchText: Za otobisi zagenewe gutwara abanyeshuri zishobora gushyirwaho amatara abiri asa n'icunga rihishije amyasa kugirango yerekane ko zihagaze no kwerekana ko bagomba kwitonda, ayo matara ashyirwaho ku buryo bukurikira :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 77: Amatara ya Otobisi Z'Abanyeshuri
lawDetails: Otobisi zitwara abanyeshuri zishobora gushyirwaho amatara abiri asa n'icunga rihishije (orange) amyasa, RIMWE RISHYIRWA IMBERE IRINDI INYUMA, yatsa igihe zihagaze abanyeshuri binjira cyangwa basohoka. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Rimwe rishyirwa imbere irindi inyuma).
memoryTip: Otobisi z'abanyeshuri: amatara 2 y'icunga rihishije (rimwe imbere, irindi inyuma).

matchText: Itara ryo guhagarara ry'ibara ritukura rigomba kugaragara igihe ijuru rikeye nibura mu ntera ikurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 54: Intera y'Itara ryo Guhagarara (Feu Stop)
lawDetails: Itara ryo guhagarara (stop) ry'ibara ritukura rigomba kugaragara nibura mu ntera ya METERO 100 KU MANYWA na METERO 20 MU IJORO (cyangwa metero 150/50 bitewe n'ubunini bw'ikinyabiziga). Kubera ko amahitamo yatanzwe arimo amakosa ku bipimo by'amategeko, igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Itara ryo guhagarara (stop) rigomba kubonwa ku manywa na nijoro mu ntera zagenwe.

matchText: Iyo umuvuduko w'ibinyabiziga bidapakiye ushobora kurenga km50 mu isaha ahategamye, bigomba kuba bifite ibikoresho by'ihoni byumvikanira mu ntera:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 87: Intera y'Ihoni ku Binyabiziga Birenza Km 50/h
lawDetails: Iyo umuvuduko w'ikinyabiziga kidapakiye ushobora kurenga km 50 mu isaha ahategamye, kigomba kuba gifite ibikoresho by'ihoni byumvikanira mu ntera itari munsi ya METERO 50. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Metero 50).
memoryTip: Ihoni ku kinyabiziga kirenga 50 km/h ryumvikanira muri metero 50.

matchText: Birabujijwe kugenza ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri naza romoruki zikururwa nabyo, iyo ibiziga byambaye inziga zidahagwa cyangwa inziga zikururuka zifite umubyimba uri hasi ya cm 4. Ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa kubinyabiziga bikurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 83: Inziga Zidahagwa n'Amapine
lawDetails: Birabujijwe kugenza ibinyabiziga bifite inziga zidahagwa zifite umubyimba uri hasi ya cm 4 mu muhanda wa kaburimbo keretse ibinyabiziga byihariye. Iri tegeko rireba ibinyabiziga byose nta kurobanura ibya gisirikare cyangwa ibya polisi. Bityo igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Inziga zidahagwa ziri munsi ya cm 4 zibujijwe ku binyabiziga byose mu nzira nyabagendwa.

matchText: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kigarukira ku mirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye kandi gifite ubugari budahagije kugira ngo imodoka zitambuke neza, kiba ari:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 112: Inzira y'Ibinyamitende
lawDetails: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kigarukira ku mirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye gifite ubugari budahagije kugira ngo imodoka zitambuke neza, kiba ari: AHANYURWA N'IBINYAMITENDE (Piste cyclable). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Ahanyurwa n'ibinyamitende).
memoryTip: Imirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye ifunganye = Ahanyurwa n'ibinyamitende.

matchText: Ubugari bwa romoruki ntiburenza ubugari bw'ikinyabiziga kiyikurura iyo ikuruwe n'ibinyabiziga bikurikira:
correctText: Ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande rwayo
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 80: Ubugari bwa Romoruki y'Ipikipiki Ifite Akanyabiziga Kometseho
lawDetails: Ubugari bwa romoruki ntiburenza ubugari bw'ikinyabiziga kiyikurura iyo ikuruwe n'IPIKIPIKI IFITE AKANYABIZIGA KOMETSE KU RUHANDE RWAYO (side-car). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande rwayo).
memoryTip: Romoruki y'ipikipiki ifite side-car ntirenza ubugari bw'iyo pikipiki.

matchText: Iyo hatarimo indi myanya birabujijwe gutwara ku ntebe y'imbere y'imodoka abana badafite imyaka:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 27: Umutekano w'Abana ku Ntebe y'Imbere
lawDetails: Birabujijwe gutwara ku ntebe y'imbere y'imodoka abana badafite IMYAKA 12 igihe hari indi myanya y'inyuma mu kinyabiziga, mu rwego rwo kwirinda ibikomere by'impanuka n'imbaraga za airbag. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Imyaka 12).
memoryTip: Abana bari munsi y'imyaka 12 ntibemerewe kwicara imbere iyo hari indi myanya inyuma.

matchText: Icyapa kivuga gutambuka mbere y'ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere gifite amabara akurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 96: Icyapa cyo Gutambuka Mbere y'Ibinyabiziga Biturutse Imbere
lawDetails: Icyapa cyerekana gutambuka mbere y'ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere gifite ubuso bw'ubururu (kare cyangwa urukiramende) rufite akambi k'umweru kareba hejuru n'akambi gatukura kareba hasi. Kubera ko amahitamo arimo amakosa ku mabara nyayo, igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Icyapa cyo gutambuka mbere gifite ubuso bw'ubururu n'utwambi tubiri (umweru n'umutuku).

matchText: Ni ryari itegeko rigenga gutambuka mbere kw'iburyo rikurikizwa mu masangano:
correctText: A na B ni ibisubizo by'ukuri
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 15: Ihame ryo Gutambuka Mbere kw'Iburyo (Priorité à droite)
lawDetails: Ihame ryo gutambuka mbere kw'iburyo rikurikizwa mu masangano: (A) Iyo nta cyapa cyo gutambuka mbere gihari, na (B) Iyo ikimenyetso kimurika kidakora cyangwa cyazimye. Kubera ko ibyo byombi ari ukuri, igisubizo ni C (A na B ni ibisubizo by'ukuri).
memoryTip: Gutambuka mbere kw'iburyo bikurikizwa iyo nta cyapa gihari cyangwa amatara adakora.

matchText: Ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda kw'ibinyabiziga bishyirwa iburyo bw'umuhanda. Ariko bishobora no gushyirwa ibumoso cyangwa hejuru y'umuhanda:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 108: Imishyirirwe y'Amatara yo mu Muhanda
lawDetails: Ibimenyetso bimurika bishyirwa iburyo bw'umuhanda, ariko bishobora no gushyirwa ibumoso cyangwa hejuru y'umuhanda KUGIRA NGO BIRUSHEHO KUGARAGARA NEZA ku bayobozi bagenda muri uwo muhanda. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Kugirango birusheho kugaragara neza).
memoryTip: Amatara ashyirwa hejuru cyangwa ibumoso kugira ngo arusheho kugaragara neza.

matchText: Iyo itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa rikoreshejwe mu masangano y'amayira ahwanyije agaciro rishyirwa ahagana he:
correctText: a na b ni ibisubizo by' ukuri
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 108: Itara ry'Umuhondo Rimyatsa mu Masangano
lawDetails: Iyo itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa rikoreshejwe mu masangano, risaba abayobozi kwitonda no gutanga inzira ku baturutse iburyo kuko amategeko asanzwe yo gutambuka mbere kw'iburyo ari yo akurikizwa. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (A na B ni ibisubizo by'ukuri).
memoryTip: Umuhondo umyatsa = Witonde kandi uhe inzira abaturutse iburyo.

matchText: Inkombe z'inzira nyabagendwa cyangwa z'umuhanda zishobora kugaragazwa n'ibikoresho ngarurarumuri. Ibyo bikoresho bigomba gushyirwaho ku buryo abagenzi babibona :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 115: Kugaragaza Inkombe z'Umuhanda
lawDetails: Inkombe z'inzira nyabagendwa cyangwa z'umuhanda zishobora kugaragazwa n'utugarurarumuri, imbibi zigaragaza inkengero, cyangwa imirongo yera iranga inkombe mpimbano. Igisubizo gikurikizwa kiba A na B cyangwa D bitewe n'amahitamo y'ikizamini.
memoryTip: Inkombe zigaragazwa n'utugarurarumuri n'imbibi ziri ku nkombe.

matchText: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira bigomba gukorerwa isuzumwa rimwe mu mezi 6:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 14: Ibinyabiziga Bisuzumwa Buri Mezi 6
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara abagenzi muri rusange, ibitwara ibintu birengeje toni 3.5, n'ibyigisha gutwara bigomba gukorerwa isuzumwa rimwe mu mezi 6. Kubera ko ibyo byose bisuzumwa buri mezi 6, igisubizo ni D (Ibisubizo byose ni ukuri).
memoryTip: Abagenzi, imitwaro irenga toni 3.5, n'ibyigisha gutwara byose bisuzumwa buri mezi 6.

matchText: Iyo kuyobya umuhanda ari ngombwa bigaragazwa kuva aho uhera no kuburebure bwawo n'icyapa gifite ubuso bw'amabara akurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 105: Icyapa cyo Kuyobya Umuhanda (Déviation)
lawDetails: Iyo kuyobya umuhanda ari ngombwa, bigaragazwa n'icyapa gifite ubuso bw'ibara ry'UBURURU (cyangwa umuhondo mu gihe cy'imirimo y'agateganyo) kirimo amagambo cyangwa akambi k'umweru kerekeza inzira nshya. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Ubururu).
memoryTip: Icyapa cyo kuyobya umuhanda kigira ubuso bw'ubururu.

matchText: Ku mihanda ibyapa bikurikira bigomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bumwe:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 89: Imigaragarire y'Ibyapa byo mu Muhanda
lawDetails: Ku muhanda umwe, ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka bigomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bumwe (kumurika cyangwa kugarura urumuri) kugira ngo byorohe kubibona no kubitandukanya mu ijoro n'amanywa. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka).
memoryTip: Ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka bigomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bumwe.

matchText: Ni iyihe feri ituma imodoka igenda buhoro kandi igahagarara ku buryo bwizewe bubangutse kandi nyabwo, uko imodoka yaba yikoreye kose yaba igeze ahacuramye cyangwa ahaterera:

lawDetails: Hanze y'insisiro, umuvuduko ntarengwa w'imodoka zitwara abantu muri rusange cyangwa ibinyabiziga bipakira ibintu birengeje toni 3.5 ni KM 60 MU ISAHA (60 km/h). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Km 60 mu isaha).

lawDetails: Iyo ikinyabiziga gikuruye romoruki yoroheje (uburemere butarengeje ibiro 750), umuvuduko ntarengwa hanze y'insisiro ni KM 75 MU ISAHA (75 km/h). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Km 75 mu isaha).

lawDetails: Ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini: (A) Ahatarengeje metero 1 imbere cyangwa inyuma y'ikindi kinyabiziga; (B) Ahantu hari ibimenyetso bibuza; (C) Aho abanyamaguru banyura ngo bakikire inkomyi. Kubera ko aho hose bibujijwe, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Ibisubizo byose nibyo).

lawDetails: Kuva bwije kugeza bukeye cyangwa mu bihe by'imvura n'ibihu igihe bitagishoboka kubona muri metero 200, ikinyabiziga kigomba gucana amatara yacyo (amagufi cyangwa maremare bitewe n'aho kigeze). Amahitamo yatanzwe arimo amakosa ku bisabwa by'itegeko, bityo igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Amatara acanwa nijoro n'amanywa igihe cy'ibihu iyo utabona muri metero 200.

matchText: Utuyira turi ku mpande z'umuhanda n' inkengero zigiye hejuru biharirwa abanyamaguru mu bihe bikurikira:

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 12: Utuyira n'Inkengero z'Umuhanda ku Banyamaguru
lawDetails: Utuyira turi ku mpande z'umuhanda n'inkengero zigiye hejuru biharirwa abanyamaguru, uretse iyo hari amategeko yihariye yerekanwa n'ibyapa byabigenewe abyemera ku bandi bakoresha umuhanda. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C.
memoryTip: Inkengero zigiye hejuru ziharirwa abanyamaguru gusa keretse ibyapa bitegetse ukundi.

matchText: Imburira zimurika zemerewe gukoreshwa kugirango bamenyeshe umuyobozi ko bagiye kumunyuraho aha hakurikira:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 31: Imburira Zimurika mu Kunyuranaho
lawDetails: Imburira zimurika (gukongeza amatara magufi na maremare mu buryo bwo kwakira) zemerewe gukoreshwa gusa kugira ngo bamenyeshe umuyobozi uri imbere ko bagiye kumunyuraho nijoro cyangwa amanywa bitabangamiye abandi. Amahitamo yatanzwe arimo ibinyuranye n'amategeko, bityo igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Kucana amatara maremare n'amagufi byihuse bikoreshwa nk'imburira mu kunyuranaho.

matchText: Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ntibushobora kurenga ½ cy'uburemere bw'ikinyabiziga gikurura nubw'umuyobozi kuri romoruki zikurikira :

lawDetails: Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bwa romoruki idafite feri y'urugendo ntibushobora kurenga kimwe cya kabiri (1/2) cy'uburemere bw'ikinyabiziga kiyikurura kidapakiye, kandi ntiburenze ibiro 750. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Romoruki idafite feri y'urugendo).

matchText: Ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari bufite ibipimo bikurikira bigomba kugira amatara ndangaburumbarare :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 52: Amatara Ndangaburumbarare (Feux d'encombrement)
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari burenga METERO 2 NA SANTIMETERO 10 (2.10m) bigomba kugira amatara ndangaburumbarare amurika imbere (umweru) n'inyuma (umutuku) agaragaza impande z'ikinyabiziga kure. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Metero 2 na cm 10).

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 62: Intera Ntarengwa y'Amatara ku Nkombe y'Ikinyabiziga
lawDetails: Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa akagarurarumuri bishobora kuba bifunze ku buryo uruhande rwayo rw'inyuma rurenga SANTIMETERO 40 (cm 40) uvuye ku mpera y'ikinyabiziga. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Cm 40).
memoryTip: Amatara ntashobora kuba kure y'impera y'ikinyabiziga hejuru ya cm 40.

correctText: itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga numero y'ikinyabiziga inyuma
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 50: Ubusobanuro bw'Amatara Ahuje Ubwoko
lawDetails: Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite amatara abiri cyangwa menshi y'ubwoko bumwe, ayo matara agomba kugira ibara rimwe n'ingano imwe, uretse itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga nimero y'ikinyabiziga (itara rya plaquette). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga numero y'ikinyabiziga).
memoryTip: Amatara y'ubwoko bumwe agira ibara rimwe keretse iribonesha nimero ya plaquette.

matchText: Ahari hejuru cyane y'ubuso bumurika h'amatara ndangambere na ndanganyuma ntihashobora kuba aharenze ibipimo bikurikira hejuru y'ubutaka iyo ikinyabiziga kidapakiye:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 51: Ubuhagarike Ntarengwa bw'Amatara Ndanga
lawDetails: Ahari hejuru cyane y'ubuso bumurika h'amatara ndangambere n'aya ndanganyuma ntihashobora kurenga METERO 1 NA SANTIMETERO 90 (1.90m) uvuye ku butaka. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (m 1 na cm 90).
memoryTip: Ubuhagarike bw'amatara ndanga ntiburenga metero 1.90 uvuye ku butaka.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 11: Kugenda Moteri Itaka cyangwa Vitesi Idakora
lawDetails: Birabujijwe kugenda mu nzira nyabagendwa moteri itaka (point mort) cyangwa vitesi idakora, keretse IGIHE IKINYABIZIGA GIKURUWE N'IKINDI KINYABIZIGA mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Igihe gikuruwe n'ikindi kinyabiziga).
memoryTip: Kugenda point mort birabujijwe keretse ukuruwe n'ikindi kinyabiziga.

matchText: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye ushobora gucibwa ku muhanda kugirango ugaragaze ibi bikurikira:

lawDetails: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye ucibwa ku muhanda kugira ngo ugaragaze INKOMBE MPHIMBANO Z'UMUHANDA, utandukanya umuhanda nyirizina n'inkengero z'umuhanda. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Inkombe mpimbano z'umuhanda).
memoryTip: Umurongo mugari wera ku nkengero = Inkombe mpimbano z'umuhanda.

lawDetails: Amategeko y'umuhanda ategeka amatara ndangacyerekezo (clignotants) n'itara ryera ryo gusubira inyuma. Amatara y'inyongera atagenwe n'itegeko ntiyemewe. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).

lawDetails: Itara ry'ubururu rimyatsa riboneka mu mpande zose rishyirwa gusa ku BINYABIZIGA NDAKUMIRWA (véhicules prioritaires: polisi, amamodoka y'abasirikare mu butumwa, ingobyi z'abarwayi/ambulance, n'izimya-nkongi) igihe biri mu butumwa bwihutirwa. lawDetails: Romoruki iziritse ku kinyamitende cyangwa pikipiki igomba kugira itara ryera cyangwa ry'umuhondo imbere, n'itara ritukura hamwe n'akagarurarumuri ka mpandeshatu inyuma. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.

lawDetails: Iyo imizigo igizwe n'ibinyampeke, ikawa, ipamba idatonoye, ibyatsi, cyangwa ibishingwe, ubugari bwayo bwemewe bushobora kugeza kuri METERO 2 NA SANTIMETERO 75 (2.75m), mu gihe ubugari busanzwe buba 2.50m. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (m 2.75).

lawDetails: Intera iri hagati y'imitambiko yegeranye ku kinyabiziga n'iyikururana igengwa n'ibipimo by'ubukanishi n'uburemere bwemewe. Igisubizo gikurikizwa mu kizamini ni C (m 7).

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 83: Inziga Zidahagwa n'Amapine
lawDetails: Birabujijwe kugenza ibinyabiziga bifite inziga zidahagwa zifite umubyimba uri hasi ya cm 4 mu muhanda wa kaburimbo keretse ibinyabiziga byihariye. Iri tegeko rireba ibinyabiziga byose nta kurobanura ibya gisirikare cyangwa ibya polisi. Bityo igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).

lawDetails: Imirongo yo mu muhanda itanga amabwiriza agenga uburyo bwo kugendera mu bisate bitandukanye. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **C. ahanyurwa n'abanyamaguru**.
memoryTip: Imirongo yo mu muhanda: ahanyurwa n'abanyamaguru.

lawDetails: Birabujijwe gutwara ku ntebe y'imbere y'imodoka abana badafite IMYAKA 12 igihe hari indi myanya y'inyuma mu kinyabiziga, mu rwego rwo kwirinda ibikomere by'impanuka n'imbaraga za airbag. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Imyaka 12).

matchText: Iyo ikinyabiziga kitagikora cyangwa cyoherejwe mu mahanga burundu ibyapa ndanga bigomba gukurwaho bikoherezwa mu biro by'imisoro, ibyo bikorwa mu gihe kingana gute:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 6: Gusubiza Ibyapa Iyo Ikinyabiziga Gikurweho
lawDetails: Iyo ikinyabiziga kitagikora cyangwa cyoherejwe mu mahanga burundu, nyiracyo ategetswe gusubiza ibyapa ndanga (plaques) mu biro by'iyandikisha mu gihe cy'AMEZI ABIRI (amezi 2). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Amezi abiri).

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 115: Kugaragaza Inkombe z'Umuhanda
lawDetails: Inkombe z'inzira nyabagendwa cyangwa z'umuhanda zishobora kugaragazwa n'utugarurarumuri, imbibi zigaragaza inkengero, cyangwa imirongo yera iranga inkombe mpimbano. Igisubizo gikurikizwa kiba A na B cyangwa D bitewe n'amahitamo y'ikizamini.
memoryTip: Inkombe zigaragazwa n'utugarurarumuri n'imbibi ziri ku nkombe.

matchText: Iyo kuyobya umuhanda ari ngombwa bigaragazwa kuva aho uhera no kuburebure bwawo n'icyapa gifite ubuso bw'amabara akurikira:

lawDetails: Iyo kuyobya umuhanda ari ngombwa, bigaragazwa n'icyapa gifite ubuso bw'ibara ry'UBURURU (cyangwa umuhondo mu gihe cy'imirimo y'agateganyo) kirimo amagambo cyangwa akambi k'umweru kerekeza inzira nshya. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Ubururu).

matchText: Ku mihanda yagenwe na minisitiri ubifite mu nshingano ibyapa biburira n'ibyapa byerekana bigomba kugaragazwa kuva bwije kugera bukeye n'urumuri rwihariye cyangwa amatara ku mihanda cyangwa ibintu ngarurarumuri. Igihe ijuru rikeye intera y'ahagaragara igomba kuba nibura:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 46-78: Amategeko y'Amatara n'Utugarurarumuri
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa mu Rwanda bigomba kugira amatara yujuje ibipimo by'uburebure, intera yo kumurika n'amabara yagenwe n'itegeko. Kuri iki kibazo, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **D. nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo**.
memoryTip: Amatara n'utugarurarumuri: nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo.

matchText: Ibizirikisho by'iminyururu cyangwa by'insinga kimwe n'ibindi by'ingoboka bikoreshwa gusa igihe nta kundi umuntu yabigenza kandi nta kindi bigiriwe uretse gusa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigere aho kigomba gukorerwa kandi nturenze na rimwe km 20 mu isaha, ibyo bizirikisho bigaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
correctText: icyapa cyera cya mpande enye zingana gifite cm 30 kuri buri ruhande
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 82: Ibizirikisho by'Ibinyabiziga Bikururana
lawDetails: Ibizirikisho by'ingoboka (nk'iminyururu cyangwa insinga) bikoreshwa gusa igihe ikinyabiziga cyagize ikibazo kikaba kigiye gukururwa cyane cyane ku ntera ngufi, kandi bigomba kugaragazwa n'agatambaro gatukura cyangwa ikimenyetso cyihariye. Igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Ibizirikisho by'ingoboka bikoreshwa mu butabazi bw'igihe gito gusa.

matchText: Uretse mu mijyi, kuyindi mihanda yagenywe na minisiteri ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n'abantu, uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ku binyabiziga bifatanye bifite imitambiko itatu ni:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 73: Uburemere Ntarengwa ku Mutambiko (Charge à l'essieu)
lawDetails: Uretse mu mijyi, ku yindi mihanda yagenwe na Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n'abantu, uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ku mutambiko umwe (essieu simple) w'ikinyabiziga ni TONI 12 (ku mitambiko y'ikoranabuhanga ritwaza imitwaro minini). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Toni 12).
memoryTip: Uburemere ntarengwa ku mutambiko wemewe ku mihanda minini bugera kuri toni 12.

matchText: Uretse mu mujyi kuyindi mihanda yajyenwe na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu, uburemere ntarengwa ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu cyangwa irenga hatarimo mukuzungu ni :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 81: Uburemere Ntarengwa ku Mihanda y'Igihugu
lawDetails: Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ku kinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana ku mihanda yagenwe na Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu bugengwa n'imitambiko (toni 10, toni 12 cyangwa toni 16 bitewe n'imiterere y'umuhanda n'imitambiko). Igisubizo gikurikizwa mu kizamini ni C (Toni 16 cyangwa Toni 12).
memoryTip: Uburemere ntarengwa ku mihanda igenwa na Minisitiri bugengwa n'amategeko y'imitambiko.

matchText: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by'umwihariko umuvuduko ntarengwa ku modoka zidafite ibizibuza kwiceka kuberako ariko zakozwe ni:
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 18-24: Amategeko Agenga Umuvuduko Ntarengwa
lawDetails: Mu mategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda, umuvuduko ntarengwa ugengwa n'akarere (mu nsisiro 40 km/h) n'ubwoko bw'ikinyabiziga. Kuri iki kibazo, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **C. km 25 mu isaha**.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 18-24: Amategeko Agenga Umuvuduko Ntarengwa
lawDetails: Mu mategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda, umuvuduko ntarengwa ugengwa n'akarere (mu nsisiro 40 km/h) n'ubwoko bw'ikinyabiziga. Kuri iki kibazo, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **D. nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo**.

correctText: imbere y'ahantu nyabagendwa hinjirwa n'ahasohokerwa n'abantu benshi
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 38: Ahantu Habujijwe Guhagarara Akanya Kanini
lawDetails: Ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini: (A) Ahatarengeje metero 1 imbere cyangwa inyuma y'ikindi kinyabiziga; (B) Ahantu hari ibimenyetso bibuza; (C) Aho abanyamaguru banyura ngo bakikire inkomyi. Kubera ko aho hose bibujijwe, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Ibisubizo byose nibyo).

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 50: Amatara y'Inyuma mu Gihe cy'Ibihu n'Imvura
lawDetails: Iyo kuva bwije kugeza bukeye cyangwa bitewe n'ibihu n'imvura bidashoboka kubona muri metero 200, inyuma y'ikinyabiziga cyangwa uruhererekane rw'ibinyabiziga hagomba kugaragarira itara ry'umutuku ritwariwe ibumoso n'umuntu uri ku murongo w'inyuma hafi y'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Itara ry'umutuku ry'inyuma rigomba guhora rigaragarira ku ruhande rw'ibumoso.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 31: Imburira Zimurika mu Kunyuranaho
lawDetails: Imburira zimurika (gukongeza amatara magufi na maremare mu buryo bwo kwakira) zemerewe gukoreshwa gusa kugira ngo bamenyeshe umuyobozi uri imbere ko bagiye kumunyuraho nijoro cyangwa amanywa bitabangamiye abandi. Amahitamo yatanzwe arimo ibinyuranye n'amategeko, bityo igisubizo ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Kucana amatara maremare n'amagufi byihuse bikoreshwa nk'imburira mu kunyuranaho.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 52: Amatara Ndangaburumbarare (Feux d'encombrement)
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari burenga METERO 2 NA SANTIMETERO 10 (2.10m) bigomba kugira amatara ndangaburumbarare amurika imbere (umweru) n'inyuma (umutuku) agaragaza impande z'ikinyabiziga kure. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Metero 2 na cm 10).

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 77: Ubutumburuke bw'Amatara n'Utugarurarumuri
lawDetails: Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa akagarurarumuri bishobora kuba biri munsi ya santimetero 40 (cm 40) kuva ku butaka, keretse kamenabihu n'iryo gusubira inyuma. Kubera ko nta mahitamo muri A, B, C yatanze iki gipimo cy'ukuri cy'itegeko, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 51: Ubuhagarike Ntarengwa bw'Amatara Ndanga
lawDetails: Ahari hejuru cyane y'ubuso bumurika h'amatara ndangambere n'aya ndanganyuma ntihashobora kurenga METERO 1 NA SANTIMETERO 90 (1.90m) uvuye ku butaka. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (m 1 na cm 90).
memoryTip: Ubuhagarike bw'amatara ndanga ntiburenga metero 1.90 uvuye ku butaka.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 56: Amatara yo Gusubira Inyuma n'Ay'Icyerekezo
lawDetails: Amategeko y'umuhanda ategeka amatara ndangacyerekezo (clignotants) n'itara ryera ryo gusubira inyuma. Amatara y'inyongera atagenwe n'itegeko ntiyemewe. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri kirimo).
memoryTip: Amatara yose agengwa n'amategeko y'Iteka rya Perezida.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 72: Ubugari bw'Imizigo ku Ipikipiki ifite Akanyabiziga k'Impande
lawDetails: Ubugari bw'imizigo yikorewe n'ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande (side-car) ntibushobora kurenga ubugari bw'icyo kinyabiziga ku ntera irenze santimetero 30 (cm 30) ku mpande zombi. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (cm 30).
memoryTip: Umzigo ku ipikipiki ntushobora kurenga cm 30 ku mpera z'impande zayo.

lawDetails: Mu gihe telefone yawe ihamagawe utwaye imodoka, itegeko rigusaba GUSHYIRA IMODOKA IRUHANDE AHIZEWE UKAYITABA, aho kuyitaba mu ntoki utwaye kuko biteza uburangare n'impanuka. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Gushyira imodoka iruhande ukayitaba).

lawDetails: Gusiga umwanya uhagije inyuma ya romoruki bifasha umuyobozi wayo KUKUBONA MU NDORERWAMO ZAYO (rétroviseurs) no kuguha umwanya wo kureba imbere y'iyo romoruki. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.

lawDetails: Mu gihe unyura ku munyegare, ugomba GUSIGA UMWANYA UHAGIJE (nibura metero 1 mu nsisiro cyangwa metero 1.50 hanze y'insisiro) mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko yanyerera cyangwa akubitwa n'umuyaga w'ikinyabiziga. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C.

lawDetails: Iyo ukurikiwe n'ikinyabiziga gitwara abarwayi (ambulance) cyakije amatara y'intabaza n'intangarugero, ugomba KUGIHIGAMIRA AKO KANYA ndetse byaba ngombwa ugahagarara kugira ngo gitambuke nta nkomyi. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 33: Guhitamo Umwanya Mwiza mbere yo Gukata Ibumoso
lawDetails: Gushaka umwanya mwiza hakiri kare mbere yo gukata ibumoso bituma UFASHA ABANDI BAKORESHA UMUHANDA kumenya icyo ugiye gukora no kwirinda gufunga umuhanda. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 30: Kwitonda mu Kunyuranaho ku Kinyabiziga Kinini
lawDetails: N'ubwo umuyobozi wa romoruki yaguha ikimenyetso cyo kumunyuraho, ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko ukareba neza niba nta kaga gashobora kubaho, kuko inshingano yo kwirinda impanuka ari iyawe wenyine. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 38: Imiparikiro Mibi Ibangamira Umuhanda
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga biparitse mu buryo bufunze inzira y'abanyamaguru cyangwa bibangamiye urujya n'uruza rw'abandi byombi biba bihagaze nabi mu mategeko y'umuhanda. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Ibinyabiziga byombi).
memoryTip: Guhagarara ku nzira y'abanyamaguru cyangwa mu ikoni ni amakosa abangamira umutekano.

matchText: Ni gute umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yanyura kumunyegare hano?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 26: Kunyura ku Munyegare mu Murongo Ucagaguye
lawDetails: Kunyura ku munyegare byemewe mu gihe ushobora kurenga umurongo wera ucagaguye mu mutekano nta kindi kinyabiziga kiguturutse imbere, ukamusigira nibura metero 1 y'umwanya w'umutekano. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Arenze umurongo wera ucagaguye).
memoryTip: Umurongo ucagaguye urarengwa mu gihe cyo kunyuranaho nta kaga.

matchText: N'iki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora aramutse ahumishijwe n'urumuri rw'amatara yikinyabiziga giturutse mu kindi cyerekezo?
correctText: Egera kunkombe y'iburyo bw'umuhanda nibinashobioka ugabanye umuvuduko.
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 48: Icyo Gukora Iyo Uhumwe n'Amatara
lawDetails: Iyo uhumishijwe n'amatara y'undi muyobozi, ugomba KWEGERA KU NKOMBE Y'IBURYO BW'UMUHANDA, ukagabanya umuvuduko, byaba na ngombwa ugahagarara, ukirinda kureba mu matara ye ahubwo ukareba ku murongo w'iburyo. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Egera ku nkombe y'iburyo ugabanye umuvuduko iyo uhumwe n'amatara.

matchText: Niki ugomba gukora igihe wegereye ikimenyetso kimurika kiva mucyatsi kijya mumuhondo?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 106: Itara ry'Umuhondo Ridakonje (Feu jaune fixe)
lawDetails: Itara ry'umuhondo ridakonje rivuga ko ugomba GUHAGARARA mbere y'umurongo wo guhagararaho, kereka gusa iyo uhagaze wateza impanuka kubera kwegera cyane umurongo mu buryo budashoboka guhagarara neza. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Hagarara niba utateza ibyago).
memoryTip: Itara ry'umuhondo = Hagarara niba ugifite umwanya uhagije wo kubikora nta kaga.

matchText: Niki umuyobozi w' ikinyabiziga akwiriye kumenya mugihe akurikiye umuyobozi wikinyamitende ibiri kandi imodoka y' umweru iri gusubira inyuma ijya mumuhanda?
correctText: Umuyobozi w' ikinyamitende ashobora guhagarara bitunguranye
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 20: Gutwara Inyuma y'Ikinyamitende
lawDetails: Iyo ukurikiye ikinyamitende (ipikipiki cyangwa igare), ugomba kuzirikana ko bishobora guhagarara cyangwa gukatira mu muhanda bitunguranye, bityo ugomba gusiga intera ihagije y'umutekano. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Umuyobozi w'ikinyamitende ashobora guhagarara bitunguranye).
memoryTip: Ibinyamitende bishobora guhagarara bitunguranye; siga intera ihagije y'umutekano.

matchText: Aha niki umuyobozi w' ikinyabiziga yakora mugihe ashaka kujya iburyo?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 40: Kureka Abanyamaguru Bambuka Iyo Ukata
lawDetails: Iyo ukata iburyo cyangwa ibumoso winjira mu wundi muhanda, ugomba guhagarara ukareka abanyamaguru bari kwambuka uwo muhanda winjiramo bagatambuka mbere. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Guhagarara akareka abanyamaguru bakambuka).
memoryTip: Ugiye gukata ikoni areka abanyamaguru bari kwambuka uwo muhanda winjiramo.

matchText: Aha umuyobozi w' ikinyabiziga ashobora kunyura kuri aba abanyamagare?
correctText: Oya, umuyobozi ntashobora kureba imbere neza
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 26-32: Amategeko yo Kunyuranaho
lawDetails: Kunyuranaho bigengwa n'amategeko yo kureba niba inzira irangaye, guca ibumoso, no gusiga intera ihagije ku bo unyuraho. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **A. Oya, umuyobozi ntashobora kureba imbere neza**.
memoryTip: Kunyuranaho: Oya, umuyobozi ntashobora kureba imbere neza.

matchText: Aha niki umuyobozi w' ikinyabiziga yakora?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 40: Inzira y'Abanyamaguru (Passage pour piétons)
lawDetails: Iyo ugeze ku nzira y'abanyamaguru cyangwa hari abanyamaguru batangiye kwambuka, itegeko rigutegeka kubareka bakambuka mu mahoro kuko bafite uburenganzira busesuye bwo gutambuka mbere y'ibinyabiziga. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Kwemerera abanyamaguru kwambuka umuhanda).
memoryTip: Abanyamaguru bari ku nzira yabagenewe bafite uburenganzira busesuye bwo gutambuka.

matchText: Muri ibi binyabiziga bine ni ikihe kiri mu buryo bwiza bwo gukata ikoni ry'iburyo kiva mu muhanda munini kijya mu muto?
correctText: Ikinyabiziga cya mbere kiri mu buryo bwiza bwo gukata ikoni ry'iburyo
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 30: Imyiteguro yo Gukata Ikoni ry'Iburyo
lawDetails: Iyo ugiye gukata iburyo uva mu muhanda munini ujya mu muto, ugomba kwegera cyane inkengero y'iburyo bw'umuhanda mbere yo gukata (Ikinyabiziga cya mbere kiri mu buryo bwiza). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.
memoryTip: Gukata iburyo bisaba kwegera cyane uruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda mbere yo gukata.

matchText: Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora mu gihe abonye icyapa kiburira cya mpande eshatu gitukura mu muhanda?
correctText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko ateganya icyago imbere ye
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 98: Icyapa cy'Umuvuduko Ntarengwa
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'uruziga rutukura rurimo umubare kibuza umuyobozi kurenza uwo muvuduko wanditswemo. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **B. Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko ateganya icyago imbere ye**.
memoryTip: Umubare mu ruziga rutukura = Umuvuduko ntarengwa wemewe.

matchText: Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba gukora ahuye n'amatungo mu muhanda?
correctText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko zigatambuka
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 16: Kwitwararika ku Matungo mu Muhanda
lawDetails: Ahuye n'amatungo mu muhanda, umuyobozi agomba KUGABANYA UMUVUDUKO, akitonda cyane, akarinda kuvuza ihoni kuko ryateza ubwoba ayo matungo akirukira mu muhanda. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Gabanya umuvuduko, wirinde kuvuza ihoni ku matungo.

matchText: Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora abonye otobisi iri kuva aho zagenewe guhagararwamo?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 34: Korohera Otobisi Zisohoka mu Byicaro Byazo
lawDetails: Mu nsisiro, abayobozi bagomba KUGABANYA UMUVUDUKO BAKAREKA OTOBISI IKOMEZA igihe yatanze ikimenyetso cyo kuva aho igenewe guhagarara (arret de bus), mu rwego rwo koroshya gutwara abagenzi. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Gabanya umuvuduko ureke otobisi ive aho ihagarara mu mujyi.

matchText: Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora mugihe ahuye n'ikinyabiziga cyakije itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 46-78: Amategeko y'Amatara n'Utugarurarumuri
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa mu Rwanda bigomba kugira amatara yujuje ibipimo by'uburebure, intera yo kumurika n'amabara yagenwe n'itegeko. Kuri iki kibazo, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **D. Kugabanya umuvuduko witegura guhagarara**.
memoryTip: Amatara n'utugarurarumuri: Kugabanya umuvuduko witegura guhagarara.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakara iki mu gihe anyuzweho nikindi kinyabiziga?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 28: Inshingano z'Umunyuzweho (Véhicule dépassé)
lawDetails: Iyo undi muyobozi yatangiye kukunyuraho, utegetswe kwegera iburyo kandi NTWONGERE UMUVUDUKO (ukomezanya umuvuduko warufite cyangwa ukawugabanya gato kugira ngo anyureho vuba). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Gukomezanya umuvuduko warufite).
memoryTip: Iyo undi agunyuraho, ntugomba na rimwe kongera umuvuduko; komezanya umuvuduko usanzwe.

matchText: Umurongo w'umweru urombereje uciye hagati mu muhanda uvuze iki?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 110-116: Imirongo n'Ibimenyetso Byanditse mu Muhanda
lawDetails: Imirongo yo mu muhanda itanga amabwiriza agenga uburyo bwo kugendera mu bisate bitandukanye. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **A. Umuyobozi wese abujijwe kuwurenga**.
memoryTip: Imirongo yo mu muhanda: Umuyobozi wese abujijwe kuwurenga.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ugeze mu isangano ry'umuhanda ugenzurwa ni ibimenyetso by'amatara yaka agasanga ataka (adakora), yakora iki?
correctText: Guca mu isangano n'ubwitonzi nkaho ntakimenyetso kikuyobora kirimo, witondera abandi bayobozi b'ibinyabiziga
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 106: Amatara Adakora mu Masangano
lawDetails: Iyo amatara agenga amasangano adakora (azize umuriro cyangwa yapfuye), amasangano ahinduka asanzwe akurikiza itegeko rya PRIORITÉ À DROITE (gutambuka k'uturutse iburyo), abayobozi bakagendana ubwitonzi bwinshi. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.
memoryTip: Amatara nadakora, kurikiza amategeko yo gutambuka kw'iburyo n'ubwitonzi bukabije.

matchText: Ni iki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora ahuye n'ishyo ry'amatungo munzira nyabagendwa?
correctText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gutambukana ubwitonzi
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 11: Guhura n'Amatungo mu Nzira Nyabagendwa
lawDetails: Iyo uhuye n'ishyo ry'amatungo mu muhanda, ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko, kwirinda kuvuza ihembe (honi) kuko byayakangaza bikirukira mu modoka, ugatambukana ubwitonzi bwinshi. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Amatungo mu muhanda = Gabanya umuvuduko, ntukavuze ihoni.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora iki igihe ageze ku kazamuko gashinze cyane ?
correctText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko akaguma kuruhande rw'iburyo yirinda ibyago
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 22: Kwitwararika ku Kazamuko Gashinze
lawDetails: Ugeze ku kazamuko gashinze cyane, umuyobozi agomba KUGABANYA UMUVUDUKO NO GUKORESHA VITESI YIHARIYE (vitesse yo hasi) ifite ingufu zo kuzamuka neza nta gusubira inyuma. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.
memoryTip: Koresha vitesi yo hasi ifite ingufu ku kazamuko gashinze.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora iki ahuye n'ikinyabiziga giturutse mukindi kerekezo, gicanye amatara yumuhondo aburira ?
correctText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gutambukana ubwitonzi
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 46-78: Amategeko y'Amatara n'Utugarurarumuri
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa mu Rwanda bigomba kugira amatara yujuje ibipimo by'uburebure, intera yo kumurika n'amabara yagenwe n'itegeko. Kuri iki kibazo, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **A. Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gutambukana ubwitonzi**.
memoryTip: Amatara n'utugarurarumuri: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gutambukana ubwitonzi.

matchText: Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora ageze hafi y'inzira ifunganye igihe ahuye n'ikindi kinyabiziga giturutse mukindi cyerekezo?
correctText: kugabanya umuvuduko no gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati y'ibinyabiziga byombi
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 25: Kubisikana mu Nzira Ifunganye
lawDetails: Iyo ugeze ahantu hafunganye kandi uhuye n'ikindi kinyabiziga, ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati yanyu cyangwa ugahagarara niba ari wowe ufite inzitizi ku ruhande rwawe. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Mu nzira ifunganye gabanya umuvuduko kandi usige umwanya uhagije wo kubisikana.

matchText: Umuyobozi w' ikinyabiziga agendera inyuma y'ikindi kinyabizaga akaba adateganya kukinyuraho yakora iki ?
correctText: kuguma inyuma yacyo kugirango yemerere ibindi binyabiziga gutambuka
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 20: Intera y'Umutekano Inyuma y'Ibindi Binyabiziga
lawDetails: Iyo ugendera inyuma y'ikindi kinyabiziga udateganya kukinyuraho, ugomba gusiga intera ihagije ituma ibindi binyabiziga bishaka kunyuranaho bishobora kwinjira hagati yanyu nta kaga. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Siga intera ihagije ituma undi unyuranaho abona aho yinjira mu mutekano.

matchText: Niryari amatara ndanga cyerekezo agomba kugaragazwa kubandi bakoresha umuhanda ?
correctText: mugihe gikwiye ushaka kumenyesha abandi bakoresha umuhanda icyo ugiye gukora
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 46-78: Amategeko y'Amatara n'Utugarurarumuri
lawDetails: Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa mu Rwanda bigomba kugira amatara yujuje ibipimo by'uburebure, intera yo kumurika n'amabara yagenwe n'itegeko. Kuri iki kibazo, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **C. mugihe gikwiye ushaka kumenyesha abandi bakoresha umuhanda icyo ugiye gukora**.
memoryTip: Amatara n'utugarurarumuri: mugihe gikwiye ushaka kumenyesha abandi bakoresha umuhanda icyo ugiye gukora.

matchText: Gutinda gutanga ibimenyetso ku muyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ni gute bibangamira abandi bakoresha umuhanda ?
correctText: bishobora gutuma batabona igihe gihagije cyo gushyira mubikorwa icyo amenyeshejwe
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 29: Gutanga Ibimenyetso Hakiri Kare (Clignotant)
lawDetails: Gutinda gutanga ikimenyetso cyo gukata cyangwa guhagarara bibangamira abandi bakoresha umuhanda kuko bituma batabona igihe gihagije cyo kwitegura no gufata ingamba zikwiriye. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Tanga ikimenyetso cyo gukata hakiri kare mbere yo guhindura icyerekezo.

matchText: Ni ubuhe buryo bwiza bwakurikizwa igihe hari umuntu wakomerekeye mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda ?
correctText: Kutamukuramo keretse mugihe hari ibyago byaterwa n'inkogi y'umuriro cyangwa akaba ashobora kugongwa n'ikindi kinyabiziga no guhamagara ababishinzwe
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 13: Kwirinda Kunyeganyeza Indembe mu Mpanuka
lawDetails: Mu gihe hari umuntu wakomerekeye mu mpanuka, uburyo bwiza ni UKUTAMUKURAMO CYANGWA KUTAMUNYEGENYEZA keretse igihe hari ikindi cyago nk'inkongi y'umuriro, kugeza abaganga baje. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Ntukanyeganyeze inkomere mu mpanuka keretse hari inkongi y'umuriro.

matchText: Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora igihe agize uruhare mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda , aho ntawakometese ariko ibinyabiziga bikaba byateza icyago cyangwa byafunze umuhanda ?
correctText: Gushushanya aho zagonganiye no kuzishyira kuruhande
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 86: Ibyo Gukora Igihe habaye Impanuka Idakomeye
lawDetails: Iyo habaye impanuka nta muntu wakomeretse kandi ibinyabiziga bibangamiye urujya n'uruza, abashoferi bagomba gushushanya aho ibiziga byari biri bakabikura mu muhanda bakabyegereza ku ruhande kugira ngo badahagarika umuhanda. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.
memoryTip: Shushanya aho imodoka zangiritse zari ziri hanyuma uzikure mu muhanda.

matchText: Igihe umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agendera munzira y'icyerekezo kimwe akifuza gukata ibumoso yakora iki?
correctText: gutwara yegera ku uruhande rw'ibumoso bw'umuhanda
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 31: Gukata Ibumoso mu Muhanda w'Icyerekezo Kimwe
lawDetails: Mu muhanda w'icyerekezo kimwe (sens unique), umuyobozi ushaka gukata ibumoso agomba kwegera inkengero y'ibumoso bw'umuhanda mbere yo gukata. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C.
memoryTip: Sens unique: Gukata ibumoso bisaba kwegera cyane inkengero y'ibumoso.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabizaga uri kugendera mu muhanda w'ibyerekezo bibiri nuruhe ruhande rw'umuhanda agomba gukoresha ?
correctText: Mu gice cy'iburyo bw'umuhanda uretse igihe ashaka kunyuranaho cyangwa gukata ibumoso
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 16: Kugendera mu Ruhande rw'Iburyo
lawDetails: Mu muhanda w'ibyerekezo bibiri, umuyobozi agomba kugendera mu ruhande rw'iburyo gusa, akegera ibumoso gusa igihe anyuranaho cyangwa agiye gukata ibumoso. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C.
memoryTip: Gendera mu gisate cy'iburyo keretse ugiye kunyuranaho cyangwa gukata ibumoso.

matchText: Igihe umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga atwaye mu muhanda urombereje w'ibice byinshi agomba kugendera mu kihe gice cy'umuhanda ?
correctText: Kugendera mu gice cy'iburyo bw'umuhanda keretse ushaka kunyuranaho
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 101: Kugendera mu Muhanda Urombereje w'Ibisate Byinshi
lawDetails: Mu muhanda urombereje ugizwe n'ibisate byinshi, umuyobozi agomba kugendera mu gisate cy'iburyo cyane, ibindi bisate by'ibumoso bikoreshwa mu gihe cyo kunyuranaho gusa. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C.
memoryTip: Mu muhanda w'ibisate byinshi, igisate cy'iburyo nicyo kigenderwamo mu buryo busanzwe.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora iki igihe ageze aho banyura bazenguruka?
correctText: Tanga inzira ku binyabiziga byamaze kwinjira aho banyura bazunguruka
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 15: Gutanga Inzira muri Rond-point
lawDetails: Ugeze aho banyura bazenguruka (rond-point), ugomba GUTANGA INZIRA KU BINYABIZIGA BYAMAZE KWINJIRAMO biturutse ibumoso bwawe. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A.
memoryTip: Muri rond-point: tanga inzira ku banyura bazenguruka baturutse ibumoso.

matchText: Ni kihe cyerekezo umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yinjiriramo iyo ageze aho banyura bazenguruka ?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 32: Kwinjira mu Masangano Azunguruka (Rond-point)
lawDetails: Kwinjira mu masangano azunguruka bikorerwa IBURYO (mu cyerekezo kinyuranye n'icy'intambwe z'isaha / sens giratoire). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D (Iburyo).
memoryTip: Muri rond-point hinjirirwa iburyo ukazenguruka ukataza ibumoso.

matchText: Mbere yuko umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga akata ibumoso mu nzira nyabagendwa, nihe ikinyabiziga kigomba kuba kiri ?
correctText: Gusa iburyo bwo hagati y'inzira nyabagendwa
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 31: Imyiteguro yo Gukata Ibumoso mu Muhanda w'Ibyerekezo Bibiri
lawDetails: Mbere yo gukata ibumoso mu muhanda w'ibyerekezo bibiri, umuyobozi agomba kwegereza ikinyabiziga cye umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri (gusa iburyo bwo hagati mu muhanda) adarenze umurongo. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Kuri ibyerekezo bibiri, egereza ikinyabiziga umurongo wo hagati utawurenze.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakwitondera iki mbere yuko y'injira munzira banyuramo bazengurutse ?
correctText: ibinyabiziga biturutse ibumoso bwe n'umuvuduko bifite n'intera iri hagati ye nabyo
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 32: Kwitondera Ibinyabiziga Biri Muri Rond-point
lawDetails: Mbere yo kwinjira mu masangano azunguruka, umuyobozi agomba kureba ibinyabiziga biturutse ibumoso bwe biri imbere muri rond-point, umuvuduko bifite n'intera iri hagati yabo kuko aribyo bifite uburenganzira mbere ye. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B.
memoryTip: Reba ibumoso mbere yo kwinjira muri rond-point kuko ibirimo bifite priorité.

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ugendera inyuma y'ikinyabaziga gitwara abagenzi gihagaze gikuramo cyangwa gishyiramo abagenzi agomba :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 26: Kunyuranaho ku Kinyabiziga Gitwara Abagenzi Gihagaze
lawDetails: Iyo ikinyabiziga gitwara abagenzi gihagaze ku cyicaro cyacyo gishyiramo abantu, ushobora kukinyuraho uciye ibumoso bwayo witonze kandi ukitegura guhagarara kuko abagenzi bashobora kwambuka umuhanda bitunguranye. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni A (Kunyuranaho ibumoso).
memoryTip: Kunyuranaho ku modoka y'abagenzi ihagaze bikorerwa ibumoso n'ubwitonzi bukabije.

matchText: Igihe ubonye icyapa kigaragaza ishuli wakora iki?
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 98: Icyapa cy'Umuvuduko Ntarengwa
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'uruziga rutukura rurimo umubare kibuza umuyobozi kurenza uwo muvuduko wanditswemo. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **A. kugabanya umuvuduko no gukomeza witonze**.
memoryTip: Umubare mu ruziga rutukura = Umuvuduko ntarengwa wemewe.

matchText: Umubare w'abagenzi bemewe gutwarwa mukinyabiziga wanditswe mu :
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 6: Umubare w'Abagenzi n'Ubwishingizi
lawDetails: Umubare w'abagenzi bemewe gutwarwa mu kinyabiziga wanditse mu CYEMEZO CY'UBWISHINGIZI (Assurance) no muri karita y'ikinyabiziga. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C (Ubwishingizi).
memoryTip: Umubare w'abagenzi wandikwa mu cyemezo cy'ubwishingizi.

matchText: Gutwara ikinyabiziga wasinze:
correctText: birabujijwe ku binyabiziga byose bifite moteri
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 9: Kubuza Gutwara Wasinze
lawDetails: Gutwara ikinyabiziga wasinze BIRABUJIJWE KU BINYABIZIGA BYOSE nta kurobanura (igipimo ntarengwa ni 0.8 g/l mu maraso). Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni C.

lawDetails: Iki kimenyetso cy'umurongo wera ucagaguye cyangwa ukomeje kigenga imigendere mu gice runaka. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **D. Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ashobora kunyuranaho mu gihe bitateza icyago**.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 102: Icyerekezo Gitegetswe
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'uruziga rw'ubururu rurimo akambi k'umweru gitegeka umuyobozi gukurikiza icyo cyerekezo gusa. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni: **A. Komeza imbere gusa**.
memoryTip: Uruziga rw'ubururu rurimo akambi = Icyerekezo gitegetswe.

lawTitle: Ingingo ya 13: Uburenganzira bw'Abanyamaguru ku Nzira Yabo
lawDetails: Wegereye inzira y'abanyamaguru ugasanga bategereje kwambuka, ugomba KUGABANYA UMUVUDUKO WITEGURA GUHAGARARA kugira ngo ubareke bambuke mu mutekano. Igisubizo cy'ukuri ni B (Kugabanya umuvuduko witegura guhagarara).
memoryTip: Gabanya umuvuduko witeguye guhagarara ku nzira y'abanyamaguru.

matchText: Mu Rwanda, ibyapa bimenyesha ko hegereye camera zigenzura umuvuduko n'amatara (Speed Enforcement Cameras) bishyirirwaho iki?
correctText: Kuburira abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga kugendera ku muvuduko wagenwe no kubahiriza amatara yo mu muhanda
lawTitle: Ibyapa Byerekana Camera Z'Umuvuduko (Speed Enforcement Cameras)
lawDetails: Ibyapa bya camera bishyirwa mu muhanda kugira ngo biburire abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga ko hegereye camera z'ikoranabuhanga zigenzura umuvuduko w'ibinyabiziga n'iyubahirizwa ry'amatara yo mu muhanda. Ibi bifasha abashoferi kubahiriza umuvuduko ntarengwa wagenwe muri ako gace kugira ngo birinde impanuka.
memoryTip: Ibyapa bya camera biburira abashoferi kwitwararika ku muvuduko n'amatara.

matchText: Mu Rwanda, camera zigenzura umuvuduko zitangira kwandikira amande umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga igihe arenzeho ijanisha ringana gute ku muvuduko ugaragazwa n'icyapa?
lawTitle: Amabwiriza ya Polisi y'u Rwanda ku Margin ya Camera (10% Tolerance)
lawDetails: Polisi y'u Rwanda igena ko camera zigenzura umuvuduko zitanga amahirwe y'inyongera angana na 10% by'umuvuduko ntarengwa wanditswe ku cyapa mbere yo guhana. Urugero: aho icyapa kigena 60 km/h, camera itangira kwandikira amande uwageze kuri 66 km/h no hejuru yaho; aho kigena 40 km/h, itangira guhana kuva kuri 44 km/h.
memoryTip: Margin ya camera z'umuvuduko mu Rwanda ni 10% hejuru y'umuvuduko w'icyapa.

matchText: Camera zikoreshwa na Polisi y'u Rwanda mu kugenzura umutekano n'amategeko yo mu muhanda zirimo izi zikurikira:
lawTitle: Ikoranabuhanga rya Camera Zikoreshwa mu Gucunga Umutekano wo mu Muhanda
lawDetails: Polisi y'u Rwanda ikoresha amoko atandukanye ya camera: (A) Camera zihoraho zishinze ku nkingi (Fixed cameras nka 'Sophia'); (B) Camera zimurwa zitwarwa n'abapolisi cyangwa ku binyabiziga bya Polisi; (C) Camera zigenzura iyubahirizwa ry'amatara atukura mu masangano n'inzira z'abanyamaguru. Kubera ko zose zikoreshwa, igisubizo cy'ukuri ni D.
memoryTip: Camera z'umuhanda ziba izihoraho, izimurwa, n'izigenzura amatara atukura.

matchText: Iyo umuyobozi wandikiwe amande yo mu muhanda na camera abimenyeshejwe kuri SMS, agomba kuyishyura mu gihe kitarenze:
lawTitle: Igihe Ntarengwa cyo Kwishyura Amande y'Umuhanda (Iminsi 30)
lawDetails: Hakurikijwe amabwiriza agenga amande yo mu muhanda mu Rwanda, amande yose yanditswe na Polisi (harimo n'ayanditswe na camera akamenyeshwa nyir'ikinyabiziga kuri SMS) agomba kwishyurwa mu gihe kitarenze IMINSI MIRONGO ITATU (30). Iyo irenze, hiyongeraho amande y'ubukererwe (pénalités de retard).
memoryTip: Amande y'umuhanda yishyurwa mu minsi 30 mbere yo kwishyuzwa ubukererwe.

matchText: Mu muhanda, igisate cy'umuhanda cyanditswemo 'BUS ONLY' cyangwa cyashyiriweho ikimenyetso cy'amabisi kiba kigenewe iki?
correctText: Igisate cyahariwe gusa amabisi atwara abagenzi muri rusange, ibindi binyabiziga bibujijwe kukigenderamo
lawTitle: Inzira Yihariye y'Amabisi (Dedicated Bus Lane - BUS ONLY)
lawDetails: Icyapa cyangwa inyandiko y'umweru mu muhanda igira iti 'BUS ONLY' ivuga ko icyo gisate cy'umuhanda cyahariwe gusa ibinyabiziga bitwara abagenzi muri rusange (Public transport buses). Ibindi binyabiziga byose bibujijwe kukigenderamo, kugikoreramo imyitozo, cyangwa kugihagararamo akanya gato n'akanini.
memoryTip: BUS ONLY = Igisate cyahariwe amabisi gusa; izindi modoka ntizemerewe kukigenderamo.

matchText: Inzira y'umuhanda yashyiriweho icyapa kiyobora abanyamagare (Piste cyclable) igengwa n'ayahe mabwiriza?
correctText: Inzira itegetswe abanyamagare, ibindi binyabiziga bifite moteri bibujijwe kuyikoresha
lawTitle: Itegeko Rigenga Inzira y'Amagare (Piste Cyclable)
lawDetails: Inzira yagenewe abanyamagare (piste cyclable) igomba gukoreshwa n'amagare gusa. Ibindi binyabiziga byose bigendeshwa na moteri birabujijwe kuyigenderamo cyangwa kuyihagararamo kuko bibangamira umutekano w'abanyamagare.
memoryTip: Piste cyclable = Inzira itegetswe abanyamagare; imodoka na moto ntibyemerewe kuyikoresha.

matchText: Ibinyabiziga bitwara abagenzi muri rusange n'ibitwara imizigo irenga toni 3.5 bitegetswe gushyirwamo akuma kagabanya umuvuduko (Speed Governor) gatuma bitarenza umuvuduko wa:
lawTitle: Iteka rya Minisitiri ku Twuma Tugabanya Umuvuduko (Speed Governors)
lawDetails: Hakurikijwe amategeko agenga umutekano mu gutwara abantu n'ibintu mu Rwanda, ibinyabiziga byose bitwara abagenzi muri rusange (bisi, coaster, twegerane) n'ibitwara imizigo bifite uburemere burenga toni 3.5 bitegetswe kugira agakoresho kagabanya umuvuduko (Speed Governor) gatuma bidashobora kurenza KM 60 MU ISAHA (60 km/h) aho byaba bigenda hose mu gihugu.
memoryTip: Speed Governor ku bagenzi n'amakamyo > 3.5t igena umuvuduko ntarengwa wa 60 km/h.

matchText: Ku bijyanye n'umutekano wo gutwara moto mu Rwanda, ni iyihe ngingo muri izi ikurikira itubahirije amategeko?
correctText: Birabujijwe gutwara umwana uri munsi y'imyaka 12 kuri moto
lawTitle: Amategeko y'Umutekano wo Gutwara Moto — Imyaka y'Umwana (2024)
lawDetails: Hakurikijwe amategeko y'u Rwanda ya 2024 (police.gov.rw), birabujijwe gutwara umwana uri munsi y'imyaka 12 kuri moto. Kandi: (1) Umushoferi n'umugenzi bagomba kwambara ingofero ifunze neza (casque); (2) Birabujijwe gutwara abagenzi barenze umwe; (3) Icyapa 'Biremewe gutwara umwana w'imyaka 7 nta nkomyi' ni amakosa — ntabwo cyubahirije amategeko kuko abana badafite imyaka 12 babujijwe kandi nkomyi/casque ni ngombwa buri gihe.
memoryTip: Moto: Munsi y'imyaka 12 bibujijwe. Casque ni ngombwa buri gihe. Umugenzi umwe gusa.

matchText: Ni ryari umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga cyangwa ipikipiki yemerewe gukoresha telefoni igendanwa mu gihe ikinyabiziga kigenda mu muhanda?
correctText: Igihe akoresha uburyo bwa Bluetooth / Hands-free budasaba gukora kuri telefoni mu ntoki
lawTitle: Itegeko Rigenga Ikoreshwa rya Telefoni ku Muyobozi (Hands-Free Only)
lawDetails: Amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda abuza umuyobozi wese gufata cyangwa gukoresha telefoni igendanwa mu ntoki igihe atwaye ikinyabiziga. Kwitaba byemewe gusa mu gihe ikinyabiziga gifite uburyo bw'ikoranabuhanga bwa 'Hands-free' (nka Bluetooth yo mu modoka) butamusaba gufata telefoni mu ntoki cyangwa kuyangaza amaso ye ku muhanda.
memoryTip: Telefoni mu ntoki irabujijwe burundu; byemewe gusa binyuze muri Bluetooth / Hands-free.

matchText: Aho abanyamaguru bambukira (Zebra Crossing) hari amatara abiri y'umuhondo amurika asimburana (Feux clignotants jaunes), umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga asabwa iki?
correctText: Kugabanya umuvuduko akanahagarara agaha inzira umunyamaguru wese ugeze ku murongo cyangwa ugaragaje ubushake bwo kwambuka
lawTitle: Uburenganzira bw'Abanyamaguru ku Mirongo Yera n'Amatara y'Umuhondo
lawDetails: Amatara y'umuhondo amurika asimburana ku mirongo y'abanyamaguru amenyesha abashoferi kwitonda bidasanzwe, kugabanya umuvuduko, no guhagarara bagaha inzira yose abanyamaguru bari ku murongo wera cyangwa bateganya kwambuka.
memoryTip: Ku murongo w'abanyamaguru, umunyamaguru afite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere.

matchText: Mbere yo kwinjira mu masangano azunguruka (Rond-point), abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga bagengwa bate n'ibyerekezo by'ibisate by'umuhanda?
correctText: Gufata igisate gikwiye hakiri kare hakurikijwe icyerekezo baganamo mbere yo kwinjira muri rond-point
lawTitle: Ibyapa Byerekana Ibyerekezo by'Ibisate by'Umuhanda (Lane Assignment Signs)
lawDetails: Ibyapa by'imyambi mu bisate by'umuhanda bitegeka abayobozi gufata igisate gikwiye hakiri kare: igisate cy'iburyo ku bajya iburyo cyangwa imbere; igisate cy'ibumoso ku bajya ibumoso cyangwa abazenguruka bagaruka. Birabujijwe guhindura igisate mu buryo buteje akaga imbere muri rond-point.
memoryTip: Ibyapa by'imyambi bitegeka gutoranya igisate kijyanye n'aho ugana mbere yo kwinjira mu masangano.

matchText: Ku mihanda migari yo mu Mujyi wa Kigali (Boulevards / Dual Carriageway nk'umuhanda Sonatubes - Gahanga) ifite ibyapa bibyemerera, umuvuduko ntarengwa wemerewe imodoka nto ni:
lawTitle: Umuvuduko Ntarengwa ku Mihanda Migari yo mu Mujyi wa Kigali
lawDetails: Mu Mujyi wa Kigali, n'ubwo umuvuduko rusange mu nsisiro ari 40 km/h, imihanda migari yagutse (Dual carriageways) ifite ibyapa byemera umuvuduko wa 60 KM MU ISAHA (60 km/h) ku binyabiziga bito, mu gihe ku mihanda y'igihugu isohoka mu mujyi ibyapa bishobora kwemerera kugeza kuri 80 km/h.
memoryTip: Imihanda migari y'umujyi ifite ibyapa = 60 km/h; imihanda isanzwe yo mu nsisiro = 40 km/h.

matchText: Kurenga ku tara ritukura ry'umuhanda (Feu rouge) cyangwa kutubahiriza ikimenyetso cy'umupolisi uyobora umuhanda bihanishwa amande angana na:
lawTitle: Ibihano by'Amande ku Kurenga ku Tara Ritukura
lawDetails: Kurenga ku matara amurika yo mu muhanda (cyane cyane itara ritukura) cyangwa kutubahiriza amabwiriza y'umupolisi uyobora umuhanda ni ikosa rikomeye. Hakurikijwe amategeko ya 2024, amande yo kurenga itara ritukura ishobora kuba yahishuwe kugera kuri 50,000 Frw (kwemezwa kuri fines.police.gov.rw). Gitabo gya kera kivuga 25,000 Frw. Buri gihe ubaha amategeko kugira ngo wirinde ihazabu no gufatirwa ikinyabiziga.
memoryTip: Kurenga ku tara ritukura = Amande nini (25,000–50,000 Frw). Buri gihe hagarara ku tara ritukura!

matchText: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga afatwa ko yanyoye inzoga zitemewe mu gihe igipimo cy'inzoga mu maraso kirenze:
lawTitle: Igipimo cy'Inzoga mu Maraso n'Ibihano byo Gutwara Wasinze
lawDetails: Mu Rwanda, igipimo ntarengwa cy'inzoga cyemewe mu maraso y'umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ni garama 0.8 ku litiro y'amaraso (0.8 g/l) cyangwa miligarama 0.4 kuri litiro y'umwuka (0.4 mg/l). Kurenza iki gipimo bihanishwa amande y'amafaranga 150,000 Frw, gufungwa iminsi 5, no gufatirwa ikinyabiziga.
memoryTip: Inzoga ntarengwa: 0.8 g/l mu maraso cyangwa 0.4 mg/l mu mwuka. Amande ni 150,000 Frw.

matchText: Ku bijyanye n'aho abanyamaguru bambukira mu muhanda, itandukaniro ry'icyapa cya mpandeshatu y'umweru ifite umuzenguruko utukura n'icyapa cy'ubururu cya kare ni irihe?
correctText: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu kiburira ko imbere ahegereye inzira y'abanyamaguru, mu gihe icya kare cy'ubururu cyerekana ahantu nyirizina iyo nzira iherereye
lawTitle: Itandukaniro ry'Icyapa Kiburira n'Icyapa Cyerekana Aho Abanyamaguru Bambukira
lawDetails: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu (ishusho yo kuburira) kimenyesha umuyobozi ko ahegereye (metero 150-200 hanze y'insisiro cyangwa metero 50 mu nsisiro) aho abanyamaguru bambukira. Icyapa cy'urukiramende/kare cy'ubururu (ishusho yo kuyobora) gishingwa ako kanya ahari umurongo w'abanyamaguru (Zebra Crossing) kugira ngo kerekane aho yiteganye nyirizina.
memoryTip: Mpandeshatu = Iburira ahegereye inzira; Kare y'ubururu = Yerekana aho inzira iherereye ako kanya.

matchText: Icyapa kibuza ibinyabiziga bikora ubwikorezi bw'imizigo kunyuranaho mu muhanda kireba ibihe binyabiziga?
correctText: Birabujijwe kunyuranaho ku binyabiziga byose bitwara imizigo bifite uburemere burenga toni 3.5
lawTitle: Icyapa Kibuuza Amakamyo Kunyuranaho (Interdiction de Dépasser pour Poids Lourds)
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'uruziga rutukura kirimo ikamyo itukura ibumoso n'imodoka y'umukara kibuza ibinyabiziga byose bikora ubwikorezi bw'imizigo bifite uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe burenga toni 3.5 (3,500 kg) kunyura ku bindi binyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri.
memoryTip: Ikamyo itukura mu ruziga rutukura = Kubuza amakamyo > 3.5t kunyuranaho.

matchText: Mu rwego rwo gukumira impanuka z'abanyamaguru nijoro mu bukangurambaga bwa Gerayo Amahoro, abanyamaguru bagendera ku nkengero z'umuhanda badatandukanyijwe n'imodoka basabwa iki?
correctText: Kugendera mu ruhande rw'ibumoso bateganye n'ibinyabiziga bibasanga, no kwambara imyenda ibona kure (ngarurarumuri)
lawTitle: Amategeko y'Umutekano w'Abanyamaguru Nijoro (Gerayo Amahoro)
lawDetails: Abanyamaguru bagenda ku muhanda udafite inzira y'abanyamaguru (trottoir) bategetswe kugendera ku ruhande rw'IBUMOSO bw'umuhanda kugira ngo babone ibinyabiziga bibasanga imbere, kandi biba byiza iyo bambaye imyenda ifite ibara rigaragara cyangwa ngarurarumuri (reflectors) nijoro.
memoryTip: Abanyamaguru ku nkengero y'umuhanda bagendera ibumoso babona imodoka zibasanga.

matchText: Hakurikijwe amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda, ni ryari bishobora kwemerwa kunyuranaho uciye IBURYO ku kindi kinyabiziga?
correctText: Igihe ikinyabiziga kigiye gukatira ibumoso kandi cyamaze kubigaragaza n'itara, cyangwa ku kinyabiziga kigendera ku njanji (tramway/gari ya moshi)
lawTitle: Ingingo ya 28: Ibihe Byihariye Byemewe Kunyuranaho Iburyo
lawDetails: Ihame rusange rivuga ko kunyuranaho bikorerwa ibumoso. Icyakora, kunyuranaho iburyo byemewe gusa mu bihe bibiri: (1) Iyo umuyobozi w'imbere yatanze ikimenyetso cy'uko agiye gukatira ibumoso kandi agafata igisate cy'ibumoso; (2) Ku kinyabiziga kigendera ku njanji (nk'imodoka y'ishyamba cyangwa tramway) kinyura hagati mu muhanda iyo hari umwanya uhagije iburyo bwayo.
memoryTip: Kunyuranaho iburyo byemewe gusa: iyo uw'imbere agiye gukata ibumoso, cyangwa ku kinyabiziga cy'injanji hagati mu muhanda.

matchText: Icyapa kigaragaza inyuguti 'P' mu muhanda kiba kimenyesha iki abagenzi n'abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga?
lawTitle: Icyapa Cyerekana Aho Guparika (Signaux de Stationnement / Parking)
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'urukiramende cyangwa kare y'ubururu kirimo inyuguti nkuru 'P' y'umweru ni icyapa kiyobora cyerekana ahantu hagenewe guparika ibinyabiziga mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko (Parking).
memoryTip: P mu rukiramende rw'ubururu = Parking yemewe.

matchText: Icyapa kibuza kwinjira mu muhanda (Sens Interdit) gisobanura iki ku muyobozi w'ikinyabiziga?
correctText: Birabujijwe burundu kwinjira muri uwo muhanda ku binyabiziga byose biturutse muri icyo cyerekezo
lawTitle: Icyapa Cy'Uruziga Rutukura n'Umurongo Wera (Sens Interdit)
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'uruziga rutukura rufite umurongo wera uciye hagati (Sens Interdit / No Entry) kibuza burundu ikinyabiziga icyo ari cyo cyose kwinjira muri uwo muhanda giturutse muri icyo cyerekezo kuko uwo muhanda uba uva mu rundi ruhande (icyerekezo kimwe).
memoryTip: Uruziga rutukura rurimo umurongo w'umweru utambitse = Sens interdit (Ntuhinjire).

matchText: Icyapa cy'ubururu gifite ishusho y'igare (vélo) ryera gisobanura iki?
correctText: Inzira itegetswe amagare — ibindi binyabiziga bifite moteri bibujijwe kuyikoresha
lawTitle: Itegeko rigenga Piste Cyclable — Inzira y'Amagare
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'ubururu gifite igare (Piste cyclable) ni itegeko ryatanzwe n'amabwiriza y'umuhanda. Inzira yagenewe amagare gusa — imodoka, amapikipiki, n'ibindi binyabiziga bifite moteri birabujijwe kuyikoresha. Abanyamagare ni bo bonyine bemerewe kuyikoresha.
memoryTip: Ubururu + igare = Piste cyclable. Imodoka n'amapikipiki birabujijwe!

matchText: Icyapa gifite ishusho y'abantu bubatse (ouvriers/travaux) gisobanura iki?
correctText: Imbere hari imirimo y'umuhanda — gabanya umuvuduko kandi witondere
lawTitle: Icyapa cy'Imirimo y'Umuhanda (Travaux)
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'ouvriers/travaux (imirimo y'umuhanda) kikuburira ko imbere hari abakozi bakoraho umuhanda. Ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko, kwitondereza ibimenyetso by'agateganyo, no kubahiriza amabwiriza y'umuyobozi w'imirimo (signaleur).
memoryTip: Ouvriers = Imirimo. Gabanya umuvuduko, witondere abakozi bari hafi!

matchText: Icyapa cy'umwambi munini w'ubururu (flèche bleue) werekana icyerekezo kimwe gisa na ci 'Sens unique' gisobanura iki?
correctText: Umuhanda ufungura mu cyerekezo cyerekanywe gusa — inzira y'icyerekezo kimwe (Sens unique)
lawTitle: Inzira y'Icyerekezo Kimwe (Sens Unique)
lawDetails: Umwambi munini w'ubururu ni icyapa cy'amakuru (panneaux de signalisation d'information) cyerekana inzira y'icyerekezo kimwe gusa. Ibinyabiziga byose bigenda mu cyerekezo kimwe gusa cwerekanywe. Birabujijwe burundu gutera imbere mu rundi ruhande.
memoryTip: Umwambi munini w'ubururu = Sens unique. Icyerekezo kimwe gusa!

matchText: Icyapa cy'uruziga rufite umurongo umwe utukura urambura hagati (barré) gisobanura iki?
correctText: Birabujijwe guhagarara no guparika ku ruhande rw'umuhanda (No Stopping / No Waiting)
lawTitle: Icyapa kibuza Guhagarara (No Stopping)
lawDetails: Uruziga rufite umurongo umwe utukura (/) bisobanura 'No Stopping' — Birabujijwe guhagarara na gato aho hantu (haba guparika, gusitama, cyangwa gutegereza). Uruziga rufite imirongo ibiri itukura (XX) bisobanura 'No Parking' (Birabujijwe guparika, ariko guhagarara akanya gato byemewe gufuta abagenzi).
memoryTip: Umurongo umwe (/) = No Stopping. Imirongo ibiri (XX) = No Parking.

matchText: Icyapa gifite inyuguti 'P' n'umurongo utukura urambura (P barré) gisobanura iki?
lawTitle: Icyapa kibuza Guparika (No Parking)
lawDetails: Inyuguti 'P' ifite umurongo utukura urambura (cyangwa uruziga rutukura rufite P imbere) bisobanura 'No Parking' — Birabujijwe guparika aho hantu. Icyapa kinini cy'inyuguti P (P gusa nta murongo) cyerekana ahantu hemerewe guparika.
memoryTip: P nta murongo = Parking. P ufite umurongo utukura = No Parking!

matchText: Icyapa cy'umucyo utukura mu mburungushu (octogone) gifite ijambo 'STOP' gisobanura iki?
correctText: Hagarara burundu kugeza ibinyabiziga biganisha birangira nyuma ubahe inzira
lawTitle: Icyapa cya STOP (Mburungushu y'Itukura)
lawDetails: Icyapa cya STOP (octogone itukura) ni kimwe mu byapa bikomeye cyane mu muhanda. Kitegeka guhagarara BURUNDU (tires zose zigomba gusimba ku murongo wera), no guha inzira ibinyabiziga byose biganisha (mu cyerekezo cyose). Ntukore ko uhagaze barungu — ugomba kugaragaza ko wahagaraye neza.
memoryTip: STOP = Hagarara BURUNDU (tires zose). Bahe inzira bose mbere yo gukomeza!

matchText: Icyapa cy'uruziga rw'umucyo utukura gifite ishusho y'abantu babiri bataganye bagana (deux silhouettes) gisobanura iki?
correctText: Birabujijwe kunyuranaho ku binyabiziga byose (Interdiction de dépasser pour tous)
lawTitle: Icyapa kibuza Kunyuranaho ku Binyabiziga Byose
lawDetails: Uruziga rutukura rufite ibinyabiziga bibiri bitaganye ni 'Interdiction de dépasser pour tous les véhicules' — Birabujijwe kunyuranaho ku binyabiziga byose. Icyapa gifite imodoka nto n'amakamyo bitaganye cyabuza gusa amakamyo kunyuranaho.
memoryTip: Ibinyabiziga bibiri bitaganye = Nta kunyuranaho rwose. Imodoka n'amakamyo bitaganye = Amakamyo gusa.

matchText: Icyapa cy'umwambi w'ubururu werekana hejuru (flèche bleue vers le haut) ushyizwe kuri poteau gisobanura iki?
correctText: Ugomba gukomeza imbere gusa — ntushobora gukata
lawTitle: Itegeko: Gukomeza Imbere Gusa (Tout Droit Obligatoire)
lawDetails: Umwambi munini w'ubururu werekana imbere (hejuru) ushyizwe kuri poteau (panneaux) ni itegeko — Ugomba gukomeza imbere gusa. Kukata iburyo cyangwa ibumoso birabujijwe aho hantu. Ibi bisanzwe bishyirwa mu masangano.
memoryTip: Umwambi imbere (↑) = Gukomeza imbere gusa. Nta gukata!

matchText: Icyapa cy'uruziga rw'ubururu gifite imyambi ibiri yerekana iburyo n'ibumoso bisobanura iki?
correctText: Itegeko: Ugomba gukata iburyo cyangwa ibumoso — ntushobora gukomeza imbere
lawTitle: Itegeko: Gukata Iburyo cyangwa Ibumoso (Virage Obligatoire)
lawDetails: Uruziga rw'ubururu rufite imyambi ibiri (iburyo+ibumoso) ni itegeko ryatanzwe — Ugomba gukata iburyo cyangwa ibumoso. Birabujijwe gukomeza imbere aho hantu. Ibi bisanzwe bishinzwe aho umuhanda uhinduranya cyangwa mu masangano.
memoryTip: Imyambi ibiri = Kata (iburyo cyangwa ibumoso). Ntushobora gukomeza imbere!

matchText: Icyapa gifite uruziga rutukura rugaragaza ishusho y'amakamyo n'imodoka nto bigana bisobanura iki?
correctText: Birabujijwe kunyuranaho ku binyabiziga by'ubucuruzi (amakamyo) gusa
lawTitle: Icyapa kibuza Amakamyo Kunyuranaho
lawDetails: Uruziga rutukura rugaragaza amakamyo (camion) ari imbere y'imodoka nto bisobanura 'Interdiction de dépasser pour les poids-lourds' — Birabujijwe kunyuranaho ku binyabiziga bigari b'ubucuruzi (birengeje toni 3.5) gusa. Imodoka nto (légères) zishobora gukomeza kunyuranaho.
memoryTip: Amakamyo + imodoka nto bigana = Amakamyo nta kunyuranaho. Imodoka nto ziryemerewe!

matchText: Icyapa kiburira (mpandeshatu yera ifite umuzenguruko utukura) gifite ishusho y'izuba risa nk'ibyuma (neige/verglas) gisobanura iki?
correctText: Imbere hari urubura cyangwa umuhanda woroheje (route glissante) — itonda, gabanya umuvuduko
lawTitle: Icyapa kiburira Umuhanda Woroheje (Route Glissante / Verglas)
lawDetails: Icyapa kiburira gifite ishusho yerekana urubura cyangwa imiraba ireremba (snowflake / ice crystals) kisobanura 'Route glissante' — Umuhanda woroheje. Ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko, kwirinda kwamamara cyane, no kwitegereza intera yo kuhagarara kuko irekura kugabanya umuvuduko mwangu bidashoboka.
memoryTip: Izuba risa nk'ibyuma/urubura = Umuhanda woroheje. Gabanya umuvuduko!

matchText: Mu Rwanda, icyapa cy'uruziga rufite ishusho y'inzoga (verre à boisson) ufite umurongo utukura urambura gisobanura iki?
correctText: Birabujijwe gutwara umuyobozi wasinze — inzoga ku muyobozi zirabujijwe
lawTitle: Icyapa kibuza Gutwara Wasinze (Alcool au Volant Interdit)
lawDetails: Uruziga rutukura rufite ishusho y'inzoga bisobanura ko gutwara wasinze birabujijwe aho hantu (akenshi bushyirwa imbere y'aho amabisi cyangwa abagenzi benshi baga). Mu Rwanda, igipimo ntarengwa ni 0.8 g/l mu maraso. Kurengera bihanishwa amande ya 150,000 Frw + gufungwa iminsi 5.
memoryTip: Inzoga + umurongo utukura = Birabujijwe gutwara wasinze. BAC ntarengwa = 0.8 g/l!

matchText: Icyapa cy'umucyo w'icyatsi gifite umwambi werekana iburyo (flèche verte à droite) gisobanura iki mu bimenyetso bimurika?
correctText: Wemerewe gukatira iburyo ndetse n'aho itara ritukura rimurika, ariko ugaha inzira abanyamaguru bambuka
lawTitle: Umwambi w'Icyatsi (Flèche Verte Conditionnelle) ku Bimenyetso Bimurika
lawDetails: Umwambi w'icyatsi (flèche verte/green arrow) ushyizwe hasi y'itara ritukura usobanura ko wemerewe gukatira mu cyerekezo cwerekanywe ndetse n'aho itara ritukura rimurika. Ariko: Ugomba guha inzira abanyamaguru bose bambuka no kubahiriza uburenganzira bwabo. Bitari ibyo, utegereze itara ry'icyatsi.
memoryTip: Umwambi w'icyatsi = Kata nyuma yo guha inzira abanyamaguru. Ntiwirengagize abanyamaguru!

matchText: Icyapa cy'ubururu gifite iságo (maison/shelter) cyangwa umwambi werekana aho abagenzi basitara (arrêt de bus) gisobanura iki?
correctText: Ahantu hagenewe guhagararwamo n'amabisi no kuzamuramo abagenzi
lawTitle: Icyapa cy'Ahantu Amabisi Ahagarara (Arrêt de Bus)
lawDetails: Icyapa cy'arrêt de bus cyerekana aho amabisi ahagarara kuzamura cyangwa kurukura abagenzi. Izindi modoka ntizemerewe guhagarara aho cyangwa kuhagira bibuza bisi kuhagera. Abagenzi basitara aho bagomba gutegereza mu mutwe inyuma y'umurongo w'umutekano.
memoryTip: Arrêt de bus = Bisi gusa ihagarara. Izindi modoka birababujijwe!

matchText: Icyapa kiburira gifite ishusho y'abantu babiri (umugabo n'umugore cyangwa umuntu mukuru n'umwana) gisobanura iki?
correctText: Imbere hari amashuri cyangwa inzira y'abana — gabanya umuvuduko cyane
lawTitle: Icyapa kiburira Ahegereye Amashuri n'Inzira y'Abana
lawDetails: Icyapa kiburira gifite ishusho y'abantu babiri (umuntu mukuru n'umwana) kisobanura ko imbere hari amashuri, inzira y'abana cyangwa aho abana benshi bagendera. Ugomba kugabanya cyane umuvuduko (akenshi kugeza 30 km/h cyangwa munsi), kandi ugakurikira amabwiriza y'abakozi b'amashuri mu gihe cy'amasaha yo kwinjira no gusohoka.
memoryTip: Umuntu mukuru + umwana = Amashuri/Abana. Gabanya umuvuduko cyane, witondere!
